data.body:
CI regression triage and fix (real Verified-1 finding on changes 2541-2543).

Root cause: ticket 1c70's commit (change 2541) moved `${{ github.ref_name }}`
out of a run: body into a REF_NAME env var (a zizmor template-injection fix),
which broke two PRE-EXISTING tests that were not part of 1c70's held-out test
set: tests/unit/workflow/test_reconcile_workflow_lint.py's redispatch tests
(the harness statically substituted the old template string, which no longer
appeared in the run body -- REF_NAME was left unbound) and
tests/unit/test_ci_tickets_partial_clone_workflows.py::test_checkout_filter_and_preserves_inputs
(hardcoded match on the bare `actions/checkout@v7` tag, which no longer
matched once reconcile-bridge.yml's checkout step was SHA-pinned).

CI showed Verified -1 on 2541/2542/2543 (all three python versions) discovered
via a Gerrit REST vote check. Reproduced locally (6 pytest failures across the
2 files). Fixed both test files: the redispatch harness now supplies REF_NAME
directly instead of string-substituting a template that no longer exists, and
the checkout-input test accepts either the bare tag or a full-SHA pin.

Verified fix: ran both files plus all other reconcile-bridge-adjacent test
files (269 tests) green, make lint clean, then ran the FULL local suite
(`make test`) -- found 8 pre-existing failures in
tests/interfaces/lifecycle/test_atomic_completion_close.py,
test_rebar_repo_isolation.py, and test_tracker_footprint_cli.py. Confirmed via
a throwaway worktree on clean origin/main that these same 8 fail there too
(unrelated to this stack, none of these files are touched by any commit in
this stack) -- environmental (likely a local git protocol/config default),
out of scope for this epic, not fixed here.

Amended the root-cause commit (1c70/change 2541) via interactive rebase,
CAREFULLY preserving its original Change-Id (I53693a1c...) after a first
attempt accidentally let the commit-msg hook stamp a fresh one (caught before
push via diff, corrected with an explicit Change-Id in the amend body -- never
pushed the bad one). Replayed the 4 stacked commits (ecb4/2542, 2dbf/2543,
852a/2544, 22ec/2545) on top unchanged; all 5 Change-Ids verified intact
pre-push. Re-pushed the whole stack -- Gerrit correctly recognized all 5
existing changes and updated them as new patchsets (stale LLM-Review+1/
Verified-1 votes on 2541 were cleared, as expected on a content change).
